art_direction.medium: cute matte-gouache picture-book mini-character, rounded painted shapes, soft colored-ink edges, visible brush pigment and warm paper
art_direction.identity: Akshan is an adult Shuriman adventurer with warm brown skin, swept dark hair, a short neat beard, lively eyes, and a long pale scarf. Preserve his agile human proportions and ornate golden Sentinel details. His torso is fully covered by a closed cream tunic and short jacket above opaque trousers and boots; his distinctive grappling firearm is carried lowered and inactive.
art_direction.scene: The complete figure stands comfortably beside their safely supported signature object, studying one familiar detail with quiet affection. Keep the face, free hand and object in a compact clear triangle, without adding unrelated objects.
art_direction.palette: sand gold, ivory scarf, turquoise, indigo shadow; preserve canonical signature hues and skin/species colors. Supporting washes: light lilac, lemon yellow and warm ivory, with periwinkle accents. Light colored shadows and matte painted highlights.
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
art_direction.tone: cute and welcoming while preserving canonical age and species
